evidence: A drop-in, C++ rewrite of Apache Cassandra: same CQL language, partition key + clustering columns, tables of wide rows.
best_for: Very high-throughput, low-latency writes (chat, IoT, ad-tech)
verdict: Fits neatly into ONE family - it is a wide-column store.

evidence: Data is organised as measurement + tags + fields + timestamp; v3 stores it in columnar Apache Parquet files. Not one of the four classic families - it is a specialised time-series DB.
best_for: Metrics, monitoring and sensor readings over time
verdict: Does NOT fit the four classic families neatly - it is a time-series database built on columnar storage.

evidence: A multi-model database: JSON document collections, edge collections for graph traversals, and key lookups, all queried with one language (AQL).
best_for: Apps that need documents AND relationships in one engine
